# Aliveness: reference facets

Motion is a cross-cutting design preference, not a separate artifact category. The selected facet matters more than the source product's category: a tiny status indicator and a large interactive scene can both teach how an interface feels alive, without justifying the same treatment everywhere.

| Reference | What to study | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| [Shazam — Dynamic Island listening](https://60fps.design/shots/shazam-dynamic-island-listening) | iPhone interaction capture: the Shazam icon, Listening label, blue waveform and dismiss control share the expanded island. Study localized motion communicating ongoing state. | Strong motion reference, not a model for moving an entire reading surface. |
| [Jitter — Interactive Components](https://jitter.video/template/interactive-components/) | Motion-template preview with a compact thumbnail-and-text card on a gray stage. Study the composed transitions between component states, not just the template page. | Strong motion-craft reference. A preview demonstrates appearance, not the usability of a production control. |
| [Octoglow — Maxime De Greve](https://maximedegreve.com/experiments/octoglow) | Optical-code experiment: luminous blue particles coalesce into a silhouette on a dark field, with sparse Code/Camera controls and a compact settings popover. Study expressive motion as the subject, with quiet surrounding controls. | Original expressive-web seed, not an approved universal layout or functional requirement. |
| [Cosmos](https://www.cosmos.so/) | Visual-inspiration library. Open Explore: collection collages sit above image-dominant tiles, with subdued captions, category tabs and a prominent search field. Borrow the hierarchy that lets collected content supply the visual character. | Visual-only app reference, not a model for collection-workflow usability. |

The spectacle limits live with their artifacts: [Active Theory in landing pages](landing-pages.md#spectacle-boundary) and [Dithering in long-form explainers](long-form-explainers.md#visual-intensity-boundary). Their craft was admired; their intensity is not the default.

[Kinopio](https://kinopio.club/) is a spatial-thinking tool shown through freeform text and image cards, pastel connector lines, stickers and doodles. Its intentionally rough, handmade visual language was not selected. Novelty alone is not the desired personality; polished execution remains part of this profile.
